actions.action: Replace the undocumented preset with inspectable templates
actions.mechanism: Templates offer visible starting combinations, never hidden authority or automatic replacements for custom selections.
actions.implementation: List each template’s enabled permissions before application. Add a review-drafts template validated against calculated permissions; exclude publishing and billing from automatic application.
actions.check: Apply the review template: draft review succeeds, publishing and billing remain unavailable, and every original combination remains manually selectable.
actions.risk: Template descriptions can drift unless generated from their definitions.

actions.action: Require explicit selection of sensitive privileges
actions.mechanism: Publishing and billing require deliberate owner choices, including when another permission would indirectly enable them.
actions.implementation: Use separate, initially unchecked owner controls. Templates cannot select them. Before sending, block calculated publishing or billing access without the corresponding explicit selection.
actions.check: Exercise templates, copied combinations, and dependent toggles; none may send an invitation granting sensitive access without recorded owner selection.
actions.risk: Dependency conflicts need actionable explanations, not generic validation errors.

actions.action: Preserve custom combinations as first-class configurations
actions.mechanism: The selected permission vector remains authoritative; template labels describe it rather than overwrite it.
actions.implementation: Mark edited templates as Custom. Retain all selections through navigation and validation failures. Require an explicit Apply action before another template replaces them.
actions.check: Load a custom combination, change one toggle, navigate back, and trigger validation; verify every unrelated permission remains unchanged.
actions.risk: Matching a template must not trigger automatic template application.

actions.action: Show calculated capabilities beside permission controls
actions.mechanism: A live effective-permissions summary explains actual outcomes rather than expecting owners to interpret eighteen toggles.
actions.implementation: Recalculate after each change. Show Can review drafts, Can publish, and Billing access, with contributing controls linked. Mark pending results and prevent sending stale calculations.
actions.check: For known combinations, compare displayed capabilities with calculator results; changing dependencies must update the explanation before sending becomes available.
actions.risk: Overcompressed summaries can conceal less common effective privileges.

actions.action: Organize controls without hiding custom choices
actions.mechanism: Task-based grouping reduces scanning while native controls preserve complete keyboard access to every permission.
actions.implementation: Group all eighteen toggles under descriptive headings. Use native checkboxes and keyboard-operable disclosure buttons; show selected counts and keep sensitive privileges directly discoverable.
actions.check: Using only the keyboard, recreate a custom combination, inspect all permissions, resolve errors, and send; verify visible focus and no traps.
actions.risk: Collapsed groups can conceal selections unless counts remain visible.

actions.mechanism: Owner-selected capability expectations become pre-send assertions against calculated effective permissions, not additional authorization rules.
actions.implementation: For this invitation, set expectations: review allowed, publish denied. Evaluate immediately before sending; block mismatches and link to responsible controls or explicit expectation revision.
actions.check: Introduce a combination that unexpectedly grants publishing. Confirm the denial assertion fails and no invitation is sent.
actions.risk: Expectations must be explicitly revisable to preserve legitimate combinations.

actions.action: Preview permission changes before applying them
actions.mechanism: A permission difference view makes bulk template changes inspectable and reversible without discarding custom work.
actions.implementation: Before applying a template over selections, show added and removed permissions plus calculated capability changes. Offer keyboard-accessible Apply, Cancel, and Undo; preserve the prior combination.
actions.check: Apply a template over a custom combination, then undo; verify exact restoration and require fresh explicit selection for sensitive grants.
actions.risk: Undo must not restore sensitive authorization consent silently.
